ios.desc:
The Official National Lottery app is where you can play all our games. It's easy to use, and if you have an account, just log in with the same details you use for the website. 

Lotto 
- One ticket. Two chances to win. 
- The nation’s favourite game is now twice as exciting. 
- Each Lotto draw features 2 rounds. That's two chances of winning, with every line of numbers you play. 
- Tickets cost £2 per play, with draws every Wednesday and Saturday. 

EuroMillions® 
- Fulfil your ultimate dreams with life changing jackpots 
- EuroMillions offers EPIC jackpots, UK millionaire guaranteed every week and other extraordinary prizes. Get that EuroMillions feeling. 
- EuroMillions tickets cost £2.50 per play, with draws every Tuesday and Friday. 

Powerball  
- The World’s Largest Rolling Jackpot Game has landed in the UK 
- Three draws every week. Just play by 11:55pm on Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. 
- With transformational Jackpots, paid over 30 years 
- For £4 per line, there are multiple prize tiers starting with £8 for matching just 2 main numbers. 

Set For Life® 
- Win on repeat with Set For Life® 
- You could win £10,000 every month for 30 years***  
- Pay just £1.50 per line and play up to 4 weeks in advance. 
- Draw days every Monday and Thursday. 

Thunderball®  
- £1 might make your night. Win £500,000*** for just £1! 
- Draws every Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday and Saturday. 

Or play an Instant Win Game 
- In just a few taps, you could win anything from a few pounds to a life-changing million. 
- With prizes that never run out, there’s an Instant Win Game for everyone! 
- Games cost from 25p to play. 

Lotto HotPicks® & EuroMillions HotPicks® 
- Bigger prizes for fewer numbers 
- Pick and match winning balls from the main draws or choose a Lucky Dip® for randomly selected numbers.  

And don't forget, every time you play a National Lottery game you help support Good Causes all over the UK and the Isle of Man. In fact, around £33 million is raised every week**.  You help build local communities, power sports teams, save the environment, unleash creative talent, empower the elderly and unlock young potential. 

Besides actually playing, managing how you play has never been easier: 

- Enable Touch ID and Face Recognition and sign-in to your account instantly. 
- Save your lucky numbers and enter draws at the tap of a button. 
- In a rush? Scan your paper tickets in seconds to see if you’re a winner. 
- Link your bank account details to add and withdraw
